lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A bench against the wall by the lift, bolted down, upholstered in the standard grey. You have eaten lunch on it most working days for eleven years.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: If I close this quarter and go home, I eat lunch here again tomorrow, and the day after, and it is a decent bench and it is a decent life and nobody I know has ever gone without anything.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That is genuinely the choice on the table, and I am genuinely thinking about it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: You have already run the reconciliation. Whatever you decide about the bench, that is the part that cannot be un-run.
